Lightspeed halves India fund size to $250m as it sharpens strategy around AI

Funds in Market Mike Didymus - September 25, 2026 0

Lightspeed Venture Partners is targeting $250m for its fifth India fund - half the size of its predecessor - as the VC major sharpens its early-stage investment strategy in the region around artificial intelligence.

Deal Roundup: Inflexion buys into Manucurist; Abry exits Confirma to Main

Buyout Mike Didymus - September 25, 2026 0

JP Morgan Asset Management’s Natural Capital business has committed about $200m to build a large-scale sustainable forestry platform in Paraguay alongside local agricultural and forestry group Grupo Robinson.

Zero Infinity Partners boosts infratech strategy by 50% with $156m Fund II close

Funds Closed Mike Didymus - September 25, 2026 0

Zero Infinity Partners has increased the size of its early-stage infrastructure technology strategy by 50% with an oversubscribed $156m second fund close, three years after launching its debut vehicle.

Blackstone completes Eurowind deal, Searchlight backs $1.6bn Priority Technology take-private

Buyout Mike Didymus - September 24, 2026 0

Blackstone Infrastructure has completed its investment in Danish renewables developer Eurowind Energy, acquiring a 24.7% stake and committing up to €2bn to accelerate the...

Cheyne raises £3bn for ninth European real estate debt programme, more than half already...

Credit and Debt Mike Didymus - September 24, 2026 0

Cheyne Capital has raised £3bn across its latest European real estate debt strategy and adjacent vehicles, with more than half of investors' capital already deployed across a 73-loan portfolio.

Argos closes ninth mid-market fund at €736m, 64% above previous vintage

Argos has closed its ninth European mid-market private equity fund on €736m, marking a 64% jump from the €450m raised for its predecessor vehicle.

DTCP defence fund reaches €455m as EIFO, Danica join first close

DTCP has pulled in €455m at the first close of its debut defence fund, putting the vehicle within 10% of its €500m target.

British Business Bank backs Advent funds with £135m, as life sciences commitments near £750m

Funds in Market Mike Didymus - September 24, 2026 0

The British Business Bank has agreed to back two Advent Life Sciences funds with up to £135m amid an ongoing expansion in its funding for the sector.

Public pensions lifted PE commitments 24% last year to $100.9bn, despite exit squeeze

Cross Industry Mike Didymus - September 24, 2026 0

US public pension funds increased private equity commitments by 24% last year despite continuing pressure from weak distributions, putting $100.9bn into the asset class during 2025, according to new Nasdaq eVestment data.

Engine Ventures hires Oak HC/FT veteran Daubar to lead capital formation

Engine Ventures has hired former Oak HC/FT partner Michelle Daubar as partner and head of investor relations and capital formation, adding a fundraising executive who has helped raise almost $10bn of institutional capital during her private-markets career.
